meta.title: How it works
meta.description: From company lookup to a written report with ranked actions: the four steps, what you do and what we do.

howItWorks.title: Four steps. One report.
howItWorks.lead: No discovery phase, no scoping workshop. You give us the company name; we come back with where you stand and what to fix first.

lookup.title: You name the company.
lookup.body: One field on the landing page. We find the public record, the industry and the size band, so nothing is asked twice.

benchmark.title: We benchmark it.
benchmark.body: Public disclosures and peer figures give you a first read against comparable Swiss companies. Free, before anyone visits.

package.title: You pick the package.
package.body: The price is on the page and it is the price. If the benchmark shows you need less than you thought, take the smaller one.

expert.title: A senior expert visits.
expert.body: The person who walks your site is the person who writes the report. They have run safety in industry for decades.

items.name: Give us the company name.
items.access: Give the expert site access for a day.
items.decide: Decide what to act on first.

items.research: Research the company and its peers.
items.visit: Walk the site and interview your people.
items.write: Write the findings, ranked, with what each one costs.

timing.title: How long it takes.
timing.lead: From the moment you pick a package.

benchmark.title: Minutes.
benchmark.body: The free benchmark returns while you are on the page.

visit.title: Two weeks.
visit.body: Typical wait for a site visit, depending on where you are.

report.title: Ten days.
report.body: From the visit to the written report in your inbox.

closing.title: Four steps to your figure in francs.

meta.title: Expert network
meta.description: The senior EHS experts who visit your site: how they are vetted, what they have run and how one is matched to your company.

expertNetwork.title: Senior people. No juniors.
expertNetwork.lead: Every site visit is done by someone who has carried legal responsibility for safety in industry. Not a consultant who read about it.

standard.title: What we mean by senior.
standard.intro: Nobody joins the network without all four.

years.title: Fifteen years, minimum.
years.body: In an operating role in industry, not in advisory. Most of the network has considerably more.

accountable.title: Personally accountable.
accountable.body: They have held the safety role where the legal responsibility sat with them, and been audited on it.

sector.title: Sector depth.
sector.body: Manufacturing, chemicals, construction, logistics, food. We match the sector, not just the standard.

swiss.title: Swiss practice.
swiss.body: Fluent in SUVA, EKAS and the cantonal reality, in the language your team actually speaks on site.

record.title: Record check.
record.body: Roles, sites, standards, references from people who reported to them.

shadow.title: A shadowed visit.
shadow.body: Their first assessment runs alongside an established expert, both writing.

review.title: Written review.
review.body: We read the report as a client would. Vague findings do not pass.

ongoing.title: Every report after.
ongoing.body: Client feedback is scored on each assignment. The bar does not drop after entry.

matching.title: How you get yours.
matching.lead: You do not pick from a directory. We assign the expert whose sector and standards match the company, and who can reach your site. If the fit is wrong, you get another one and we absorb the cost.

coverage.title: Where we go.
coverage.lead: The network covers all of German and French speaking Switzerland, with visits arranged from the nearest expert to reduce travel.

closing.title: See what your risk costs. Then meet your expert.

trust.title: Your figures stay yours.
trust.lead: You sign for this data, so the guarantees sit in the database rather than in a policy — and the whole list is public.

residency.title: One jurisdiction, and a strict one.
residency.body: Not a policy — a region. Your figures and documents are stored on Swiss infrastructure and stay there, under the revised FADP, with the GDPR met wherever it reaches you.

isolation.title: The database says no.
isolation.body: The fence is in the database, not the app. Even a mistake in our code returns an empty result for someone else's benchmark, because the row was never theirs to read.

record.title: You can answer the audit question.
record.body: Where your data goes, and what happens there. Every company involved is named on the privacy page, generated from the code that is actually running — so it cannot fall behind the stack it describes.

purposes.ch: Your account, your figures and your documents are stored here.
purposes.eu: The site, email, payments and error monitoring run here.
purposes.us: Only the research and AI analysis steps, on the public company information we look up — never your stored figures.

meta.title: Pricing
meta.description: Three EHS snapshots at a fixed price in CHF and an implementation partner on demand. Every package includes a senior expert and a written report.

pricing.title: Fixed price. No surprises.
pricing.lead: Every package is one price, one senior expert, one report. Prices exclude 8.1% VAT.

packagesHeading.title: Three snapshots, each building on the one below.
packagesHeading.lead: Start where your questions are. Moving up a rung is a step, not a fresh start — and the partner picks up the work that follows.

items.expert: A senior expert, not a junior with a template.
items.fixedPrice: One fixed price, agreed before the first visit.
items.onSite: On site from the System Snapshot up; the Culture Snapshot runs remote in one day.
items.report: A written report with ranked actions.

vat.question: Is VAT included?
vat.answer: No. Prices are in CHF and exclude 8.1% VAT, which the invoice adds.

afterPayment.question: What happens after payment?
afterPayment.answer: You get a receipt and an order in your dashboard. Within one working day a senior expert contacts you to prepare the visit.

date.question: How is the date set?
date.answer: The expert proposes dates within two weeks of the order. You pick one, and the visit is confirmed in writing.

cancellation.question: Can I cancel?
cancellation.answer: Up to five working days before the visit, free of charge. Later, we move the date once at no cost.

closing.title: Not sure which one? Start with the free figure.

meta.title: About
meta.description: Why SME24 sells EHS consulting at a fixed price, with senior experts and without slides.

about.title: No slides. Results.
about.lead: SME24 is EHS consulting for companies that carry legal responsibility for safety and have no time for a project.

story.title: Why we work this way.
story.fixedPrice: Consulting is usually sold by the hour, so the incentive is to take longer. We sell a result at a fixed price, agreed before anyone visits. If it takes us longer, that is our problem, not yours.
story.seniors: The people who visit your site have run safety in industry for decades. No juniors with a template, no handover after the sales call. The expert you meet is the expert who writes the report.
story.noSlides: You do not need a deck. You need to know where you stand, what it costs and what to do first. That is what the report says, in that order.

disclosure.title: How this is calculated
disclosure.formula: Incidents per year = accident rate per 1 000 FTE × FTE ÷ 1 000 (with no accident rate: LTIFR × FTE × hours per FTE ÷ 1 000 000). Cost per case = direct cost per case + lost days per incident × cost per absence day. Annual cost = incidents × cost per case × the total cost multiplier; the range uses the low and the high multiplier. The savings repeat the formula at the peer median and at the top quarter.
disclosure.fteLine: Headcount is counted as full time equivalents: every employee counts as one full time job.

disclosure.correctDescription: Your values take precedence over the research and start a new computation.

changelog.1: These are the first terms of use for SME24. They set out what we provide, what a package includes, how cancellation works and which law applies.

meta.description: What SME24 collects, why, who processes it and how long it is kept.

og.statement: What we know about you. In plain words.

privacy.title: Privacy policy.
privacy.lead: This page says what SME24 collects, why we collect it, who processes it on our behalf and how long we keep it. It is written from the system itself, so it describes what the code actually does.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body: {name}, {address}, is the controller for the processing described here. Write to {email} with any question about your data, including a request to access, correct or delete it.
controller.law: SME24 is a Swiss company, so the revised Federal Act on Data Protection (revDSG, in force since 1 September 2023) governs this processing. Where a client or a visitor is in the EU, we apply the GDPR standard as well.

collected.title: What we collect
collected.lead: Three kinds of data, and nothing else.

account.title: What you give us
account.body: Your name, email address, language and the company you work for, from signing up and from your profile. Experts also give a biography, qualifications and a photograph.

work.title: What the service produces
work.body: The company facts and safety figures you enter or confirm, the research we run about your company from public sources, the benchmark we compute from them, and the orders, invoices and appointments that follow. This is the service; without it there is nothing to deliver.

technical.title: What the system records
technical.body: Server logs, error reports and, only with your consent, product analytics. Enquiry forms store a one way hash of your IP address as a flood guard, never the address itself.

purposes.title: Why we process it
purposes.lead: Each purpose, and the legal basis it rests on.

service.title: To deliver the service
service.body: Performance of the contract you entered when you ordered, or steps taken at your request before it.

legal.title: To meet legal duties
legal.body: Swiss commercial and tax law requires that accounting records be kept for ten years (Art. 958f CO). This is a legal obligation, not a choice.

improve.title: To keep the service working and honest
improve.body: Error reports, security logs and, with consent, analytics. Our legitimate interest in a service that works, balanced against processing that is minimal and never used to profile you.

consent.title: Where you said yes
consent.body: Product analytics loads only after you accept it, and you can withdraw at any time on the cookie page without losing anything else.

processors.title: Who processes it for us
processors.lead: Every third party that touches personal data on our behalf, what it does and where it stores it. A change to this list is a change to the code.
processors.usNote: The two United States processors receive company research inputs and prompts, not your account data, and are covered by the standard contractual clauses. No processor sells or reuses your data.

supabase.purpose: The database, sign in and file storage. Our instance runs in Zurich.

vercel.purpose: Hosting and delivery of the application. Our functions run in Frankfurt.

trigger.purpose: Runs the background work: research, benchmarks, invoices and email.

resend.purpose: Delivers the product email we send you.

stripe.purpose: Takes card payment at checkout. We never see your card number.

anthropic.purpose: Turns public research findings into structured facts. It receives the research text, never your account data, and does not train on it.

parallel.purpose: Searches public sources for facts about your company.

posthog.purpose: Product analytics, and only after you accept it. Our instance runs in Frankfurt.

sentry.purpose: Collects error reports so faults are found. Our instance runs in Frankfurt.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.lead: Every table holding personal data, and its period. Three honest answers: a scheduled task deletes it, it lives as long as your account, or it is kept without an end date for a reason we name.

kinds.account: As long as your account exists

enquiries_ip_hash.purpose: The hashed address behind an enquiry, a flood guard only

orders.purpose: What you ordered and what it cost

order_events.purpose: What happened to an order and when

retention.accountingNote: Orders, invoices and order events are kept for ten years because Art. 958f CO requires it. Research runs and benchmark snapshots are kept without an end date: a snapshot is immutable by design, so that a figure you were shown can always be explained, and comparing runs over time is how the service stays accurate. If you would rather they were not, ask us to delete them and we will.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.lead: You can ask for a copy of your data, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Signed in, the request is a button in your account; otherwise write to {email}. We answer within thirty days.
rights.access: A copy of the data we hold about you.
rights.correct: Correction of anything wrong. Most of it you can edit yourself.
rights.delete: Deletion, with the one exception below.
rights.object: Objection to processing that rests on our legitimate interest, and withdrawal of analytics consent at any time.
rights.complain: A complaint to the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC) in Bern, or to your local supervisory authority in the EU.

deletion.title: What deletion actually does
deletion.body: When we fulfil a deletion request we remove your name from your profile, scrub your email address and sign in details so the account can no longer be used, and for an expert also remove the biography, photograph and contact address.
deletion.exception: Orders, invoices and their event history are deliberately not touched. They belong to the company rather than to you personally, and Swiss commercial law requires them to be kept for ten years. After deletion those records no longer name you.
deletion.note: This is a fixed list executed in one step, not a case by case judgement, and it is recorded in our audit log.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We set one cookie to remember your analytics answer, and the ones sign in needs to keep you signed in. Nothing else is set unless you accept analytics. <link>The full cookie list</link>.

security.title: How it is protected
security.body: Every table enforces row level security in the database, so access is checked on each read rather than trusted from the application. Traffic is encrypted in transit, secrets are held by the hosting platform, and changes to sensitive rows are written to an audit log.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If we change how we process your data we update this page and, where the change is substantive, tell you in the app. The date at the top is always the date of the last change.

terms.title: Terms of use.
terms.lead: These terms govern your use of SME24 and everything you order through it. Accepting them at sign up is what makes them binding.

parties.title: Who the agreement is with
parties.body: SME24 is operated by {name}, {address}. Where you sign up on behalf of a company, you confirm you may bind that company, and the agreement is with it.

service.title: What we provide
service.body: A benchmark of your company's safety and health position against Swiss peer data, and, where you buy one, a fixed price package delivered by a qualified expert. The benchmark is free and is computed from public research and the figures you supply.
service.expert: Experts are qualified professionals engaged by us. We select and assign them; you do not contract with them directly.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Keep your credentials to yourself and tell us if you think someone else has them. You are responsible for what happens under your account. One person, one account: do not share a login across a team.
account.accuracy: The figures you enter drive the benchmark. Enter them honestly, because a benchmark built on wrong numbers is worse than none.

packages.title: Packages, prices and payment
packages.body: Prices are shown in Swiss francs and include Swiss VAT at the rate in force. Payment is due at checkout by card, or on the invoice terms stated on it. You get an invoice for every order.
packages.delivery: We schedule the assessment with you after payment. If we cannot deliver within a reasonable period we will say so and refund you.

cancellation.title: Changing or cancelling
cancellation.body: Tell us at least five working days before a scheduled assessment and we will move it at no cost. Later than that, or a no show, and we may charge for the expert's reserved time.
cancellation.refund: If we have not started work you can cancel and be refunded in full.

obligations.title: What we need from you
obligations.body: Access to the site, the documents and the people the assessment needs, at the time agreed. An expert who cannot see the workplace cannot assess it.
obligations.safety: You remain responsible for safety at your workplace. Our advice supports your duties under Swiss law; it does not take them over.

ip.title: What belongs to whom
ip.body: The reports, benchmarks and documents we deliver are yours to use inside your company. The platform, the methodology and the peer data behind them stay ours.
ip.aggregate: We may use figures from your company in anonymous aggregate form to improve the peer data. Nothing published this way identifies you or your company.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: We are liable for damage we cause intentionally or through gross negligence, and for injury to life, body or health, without limit. For anything else our liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the twelve months before the event.
liability.benchmark: The free benchmark is an indication built from public data and your own figures. It is not a legal audit and not a substitute for an assessment. Decisions you make from it alone are yours.

termination.title: Ending the agreement
termination.body: You can close your account at any time from the app or by writing to us. Orders already placed are completed and paid for as agreed. We can suspend or close an account that breaches these terms, and will say why.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may change these terms. If a change is substantive we raise the version and ask you to accept the new one when you next sign in, showing you what changed. Continuing to use the service after that means the new terms apply.

law.title: Law and jurisdiction
law.body: Swiss law applies, without its conflict of law rules. The courts of {city} have jurisdiction, unless mandatory law gives you a different forum.

posthog.purpose: Product analytics: which pages are used and where people get stuck. Set only after you accept.

necessary.title: The ones we cannot ask about
necessary.body: The sign in cookie and the one holding your analytics answer are strictly necessary: without the first you cannot stay signed in, and without the second we would have to ask you on every page. Neither is used to track you across other sites.

choice.title: Your choice
choice.lead: This is what you answered, and where you change it.
choice.reopened: Answer the bar at the bottom of the page.

more.title: More detail
more.body: The privacy policy says what each processor does with the data and how long we keep it. <link>Read the privacy policy</link>.

dataRequests.title: Your data
dataRequests.lead: You can ask for a copy of the personal data SME24 holds about you, or ask us to delete it. We answer within 30 days.
dataRequests.signedOut: Sign in to make a request. If you do not have an account, write to us and we will answer the same way.

filed.export: Request received. We will send your copy within 30 days.
filed.deletion: Request received. We will answer within 30 days.

export.title: Request a copy of your data
export.body: We will assemble what SME24 holds about you and send it to your account address within 30 days.

deletion.title: Request deletion
deletion.body: Your name, email address and profile are removed and you can no longer sign in. Invoices and orders are kept for ten years, because Swiss commercial law (Art. 958f CO) requires it. This cannot be undone.

errors.already_open: You already have an open request of this kind. We will answer it within 30 days.
errors.validation: That request could not be read. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: Please sign in again to make a request.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
